main_text.head: INDEX QVÆSTION.
main_text.l: 43. Quomodo iis infint, & per quam partem ingrediantur.
44. In qua hominum parte præcipue suam figât sedem.
47. Nocturna terriculamenta an ab hominum mortuorum spiritibus excitentur, an vero a cacodæmonibus.
52. An coeli obseruatione quis fascinare queat.
53. Quomodo sint diaboli ab igne æternum excruciandi.
54. De distinctione & ordinibus seu gradibus dæmonum.

page.notes: Faint show-through from the reverse page appears in the lower half of the page and is not transcribed. The catchword "Genera" is partly obscured at the right edge. Numbers 43 to 54 are printed with the reversed-form numerals as shown; Latin words in the list are copied as printed.
